expectedSignals.notes: Pod is healthy. Failure is Service selector mismatch. Requires pass-2 Service/Endpoints collection. Pass serviceName=broken-service when troubleshooting.

probableRootCause: Service broken-service selects app=wrong-label but pods are labeled app=service-demo, so endpoints stay empty.
typicalFix: Change Service selector to app=service-demo (or relabel pods).
verificationCommands: kubectl get svc broken-service -n kubeassist-lab -o yaml
notes: Diagnosing only the pod without related Services will look Healthy — UI/API must support serviceName or related expansion.
